description: This Java class 'ImportProductHelper' provides utility methods for preparing product and inventory item data maps and checking product existence in the database within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ImportProductHelper
classes.description: Utility class for preparing product and inventory data and checking product existence.

methods.name: prepareProduct
methods.description: Creates a map with product details based on productId.

methods.name: prepareInventoryItem
methods.description: Creates a map with inventory item details including quantity and IDs.

methods.name: checkProductExists
methods.description: Checks if a product with the given productId exists in the database.
